arguments.command: $c = Get-Content AUDIT_LEDGER.md -Raw; $n = ([regex]::Matches($c, '\\`')).Count; Write-Output ('before=' + $n); $c2 = $c.Replace('\`','`'); Set-Content -Path AUDIT_LEDGER.md -Value $c2 -NoNewline -Encoding utf8; $d = Get-Content AUDIT_LEDGER.md -Raw; Write-Output ('after=' + ([regex]::Matches($d, '\\`')).Count); Get-Content AUDIT_LEDGER.md -Tail 6 | Out-String -Width 240
